description: This file implements an Android notification listener service that tracks, processes, and provides access to device notifications. It includes data classes for notification entries and snapshots, methods for sanitizing notification texts, external references to Android notification APIs, and logic for filtering notifications based on policies and quiet hours.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
classes.description: Represents a notification entry with its key, package, content, category, channel, timestamps, and flags.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
classes.description: Captures the current state of notifications including enabled status, connection status, and a list of notification entries.

classes.name: NotificationActionRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates a request to perform an action (Open, Dismiss, Reply) on a notification, optionally including reply text.

classes.name: NotificationActionResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of executing a notification action, including success flag, code, and message.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService
classes.description: A service that extends Android's NotificationListenerService to monitor, handle, and manage notifications, with internal policies, state management, and action execution capabilities.

classes.name: NotificationActionKind
classes.description: Enumeration of possible notification actions: Open, Dismiss, or Reply.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Normalizes and trims notification text to a maximum length, returning null if empty.

methods.name: toJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a DeviceNotificationEntry to a JSON object for transmission or logging.

methods.name: notificationChangedPayload
methods.description: Generates a JSON payload string describing the change (posted/removed) to a notification, considering policies and rate limiting.

methods.name: refreshActiveNotifications
methods.description: Refreshes the internal store with the current active notifications.

methods.name: toEntry
methods.description: Converts a StatusBarNotification object into a DeviceNotificationEntry.

methods.name: executeActionInternal
methods.description: Executes a specified action (open, dismiss, reply) on a notification, returning the result.
